about: Prose truthfulness rules for model-authored curios (proposal 3.4). A curio's hooks can only show text and request a Sanity change of -2..2; any text promising another effect is false. Heuristic: case-insensitive regular expressions over the name and every inspect/apply text the validation grid produced. False rejections are measured in docs/measurements/.

rules.pattern: \b(gold pieces?|rings? of (protection from shape changers|aggravate monster|gain constitution|increase accuracy|poison resistance|polymorph control|shock resistance|teleport control|cold resistance|fire resistance|increase damage|sustain ability|slow digestion|gain strength|see invisible|teleportation|invisibility|regeneration|free action|levitation|protection|adornment|polymorph|searching|alacrity|conflict|nothing|stealth|warning|hunger|wishes)|wands? of (secret door detection|create monster|make invisible|undead turning|enlightenment|magic missile|speed monster|teleportation|cancellation|slow monster|lightning|polymorph|darkness|draining|striking|digging|locking|nothing|opening|probing|wishing|death|light|sleep|cold|fire)|potions? of (monster detection|primordial waters|object detection|restore ability|enlightenment|extra healing|hallucination|see invisible|full healing|gain ability|invisibility|fruit juice|gain energy|goat's milk|gain level|levitation|space mead|blindness|confusion|paralysis|polymorph|starlight|sickness|sleeping|amnesia|healing|blood|booze|midas|speed|water|acid|oil)|scrolls? of (confuse monster|create monster|enchant weapon|food detection|gold detection|stinking cloud|destroy armor|enchant armor|magic mapping|scare monster|teleportation|consecration|remove curse|blank paper|secret arts|punishment|resistance|antimagic|charging|genocide|identify|amnesia|warding|taming|earth|light|fire|mail|ward)|amulets? of (magical breathing|drain resistance|nullify magic|restful sleep|strangulation|wound closure|life saving|reflection|unchanging|Yendor|change|ESP))\b
\b(teleport\w*|transports? you|whisk(s|ed)? (you|away|off)|(you are|you're) whisked|carries you (away|off|elsewhere)|you (are|find yourself) (elsewhere|somewhere else|on another (level|floor)))

\b(you will (?!not\b|never\b)|it will (bring|give|lead|take|open|reveal|show you)|will (come|arrive|appear|return|happen) (soon|later|for you|to you)|on the next (level|floor)|later floor|next floor|tomorrow|someday)

calibration: Drafted, then narrowed once against #241's 101 parseable pilot curios: 'you will not ...' and 'summon agreement' were false positives. The witness rule was kept ('The case remembers your angle' is rejected). The rerun under docs/measurements/ is the first measurement on unseen text. Sam 2026-10-04 approved narrowing the giving clause of item_gain to an explicit recipient: (gives?|grants?|bestows?|yields?|drops?) you (a|an|some|the) followed by an item noun. The bare give-the-item form is removed: Crooked Winder's 'You give the key a half-turn' is not an item transfer. The other item_gain alternatives are unchanged. Offline recalibration covers the 92 admitted pilot curios' recorded admission texts and all recorded grid texts of the 34 rerun curios; no rejections after this change. This does not measure the miss rate. Attempt 008 (2026-10-06): the bare 'ring of' alternative rejected 'A faint ring of wear circles the bore'. item_named now fires only on '<ring|wand|potion|scroll|amulet>(s) of <suffix>' where the suffix is a real object name from src/objects.c (scrolls exclude the 'Gold Scroll of Law' artifact name; amulets add 'Yendor'), plus 'gold piece(s)'. A test re-derives the suffix lists from src/objects.c, so the rule cannot drift from the game. Spellbooks were never covered and are not added. This can admit curios the bare form rejected, e.g. prose about 'a ring of wear' or 'a scroll of bark'.
